questions.explanation: Product rule: cos(t)e^t + sin(t)e^t. The tempting wrong idea is to differentiate only the trig factor.
questions.hint: Include derivative of sin times e^t.

questions.subject: CALCULUS_I
questions.learningObjective: Spot an error in quotient rule with trig
questions.stem: A beekeeper differentiated sin(t)/t as cos(t)/t and ignored quotient rule. What is the correct numerator at t=π/2?
questions.explanation: Numerator at π/2: 0 - 1 = -1. The tempting wrong idea is to differentiate only the numerator.
